name: comp-96
blurb: Plus icon button that hides text on mobile.
description: A square Button with a Plus icon, using responsive utilities to show text (max-sm:sr-only) on desktop and hide it on mobile.
use_when: You need space-efficient icon buttons that reveal text on wider screens.
avoid_when: When icon-only buttons are unclear without text, especially on touch-only devices.
a11y: Icon is aria-hidden; text content provides meaning. Uses sr-only to hide text visually on mobile while keeping it in the accessibility tree.
